[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new pasta recipes to try out.  
[PREFERENCE] User recently made a decent chicken parmesan with fettuccine pasta last week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fettuccine is a versatile pasta shape that pairs well with a variety of sauces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for classic Italian dishes using fettuccine or similar types of pasta:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Fettuccine Alfredo: Toss cooked fettuccine with Parmesan cheese, butter, and heavy cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Carbonara: Whisk eggs, Parmesan cheese, and cooked bacon or pancetta, then toss with cooked fettuccine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Fettuccine with Mushroom Cream Sauce: Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter and garlic, then add heavy cream and grated Parmesan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Pesto Fettuccine with Cherry Tomatoes: Toss cooked fettuccine with pesto, cherry tomatoes, and mozzarella cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Fettuccine with Prosciutto and Peas: Sauté diced prosciutto and peas in olive oil, then toss with cooked fettuccine and grated Parmesan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for similar types of pasta dishes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Spaghetti alla Bolognese: A meat-based pasta sauce with ground beef or pork, served with spaghetti.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Tortellini en Brodo: Cheese-filled tortellini served in chicken broth with Parmesan and parsley.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Pappardelle with Wild Mushroom and Truffle Sauce: Wide pappardelle noodles with mushroom and truffle sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Linguine with Clams: Sauté garlic, clams, and white wine, served with linguine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Cacio e Pepe with Penne: A creamy sauce made with Pecorino Romano cheese, black pepper, and pasta cooking water, served with penne.
